title: scripts/daw-export-smoke.sh: export every example and run the set checker
description:
## Intent

A smoke check that exports every example.

## Steps

- `scripts/daw-export-smoke.sh`: build `apricity`, export each `examples/*.apr` into a temp folder, run the set checker on each (a `--check` mode of a small test binary in `apricity-daw`, or the `daw` test with an env var pointing at the folder), and fail loudly, never skip, when samples are missing, saying to run `apricity sources fetch --all`.
- Bound the run (one export at a time; runs under the watchdog).

## Verification

`safe-run.sh -- scripts/daw-export-smoke.sh` passes with the samples fetched and fails with the message when they are not.

## Release

`chore(<this task's id>): smoke-export every example as a DAW set`.
